ImageDescription.value:
Dalsland's most beautiful site to watch is Håverud, amongst other places. This picture represents the part of the Village next to the Aqueduct.

The aqueduct is a free-hanging bridge, where the water is led in a 33.5 meter long plateau above the river. The plates are joined with 33000 rivets. No rivets have yet to be replaced.

Must place to visit in South Sweden.
